item.title: Squarespace Design for Cat Boarding Business
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Project description We are the owners of Balnaclash Cattery, a family-run cattery. We have an existing Squarespace 7.1 site, logo and brand guide. We need an experienced Squarespace designer to create a warm, professional and easy-to-use website that helps cat owners feel comfortable enquiring and booking. This is a Squarespace design-and-build project. We are looking for someone with live Squarespace 7.1 sites in their portfolio, not only Figma mock-ups or experience with other platforms. We will want to see examples. We have a clear page plan and will provide final wording after the main design direction is agreed. During design, use short neutral placeholder copy with labels such as “[Final introduction to be added]”. Temporary AI-generated images may be used to help us judge layout and mood. They must be realistic images of cats in a believable cattery setting, clearly treated as placeholders, and replaced with approved real photographs before the website goes live. Pages • Home • Our Cattery • Your Cat’s Stay • Prices • About Us • Contact & Find Us • Footer links: Boarding Terms, Privacy Notice and Cookie Settings Work required • Work directly in our existing Squarespace 7.1 site as a draft. • Create the homepage design first and get our approval on the visual direction before building the remaining pages. • Build the six pages using the structure in this brief and clearly marked copy placeholders. • Set up navigation, footer, responsive layouts, contact form and Book Now links. • Use our existing logo and brand guide. Do not redesign the logo or brand. • Use temporary AI image placeholders only as described below. Keep an asset list so we can replace them easily. • Make the site straightforward for us to edit in Squarespace after handover. • Include basic page titles, slugs, mobile checks, link/form testing and a short handover. • Do not publish, connect the public domain or change domain, billing or account settings. • SEO Optimisation required to ensure appears on first page • Must optimize on Mobile, Desktop and Tablet Proposal requirements Please include: • Links to at least two live websites you personally designed and built in Squarespace 7.1. State your role and what you completed on each. • At least one example of a small service, hospitality, pet-care or other trust-led business, if available. • A brief note about how you would approach the homepage and mobile experience for this project. • Fixed price, inclusions, timeline, revision rounds and any extras. • Confirmation you can work via a Squarespace contributor invitation without account-owner passwords. • Whether you plan to use custom CSS or code, and why.
2. Brand and design direction Balnaclash is a family-run cattery at our home in the West Lothian countryside. The site should feel warm, calm, personal, trustworthy and professional. Use the existing logo and brand guide: • Forest green: #1F502E • Sage green: #7A8F72 • Antique gold: #B08A3E • Warm ivory: #F8F3E8 • Warm taupe: #C8BDA7 • Playfair Display headings; Lato body text Use generous but practical spacing, clear headings, readable text and simple buttons. Use forest green for main buttons and navigation; reserve antique gold for small accents. Do not stretch, recreate or recolour the logo.
Design priorities 1. Make it immediately clear this is a cat boarding cattery in West Lothian. 2. Make the site feel personal and reassuring through the real owners, clear information and genuine cattery imagery. 3. Make prices, care details and booking options easy to find. 4. Keep the pages simple and easy to use on a phone. 5. Use a visible Book Now button and a softer Contact / Ask a Question option. 3. Sitemap and page content plan Use these six pages. Do not add separate Gallery, Reviews, Food, FAQ or What’s Included pages. Place those elements within the most relevant pages.
Home: hero with business, location and reassurance; cattery preview; care highlights; owner introduction; price summary; location; optional reviews once approved. Actions: Book Now / Contact Us
Our Cattery: accommodation overview; family-sized sharing; comfort details; photo gallery. Actions: Explore the Cattery / Book Now.
Your Cat’s Stay: individual care; food; medication; updates; what to bring; vaccinations; veterinary arrangements; FAQs. Actions: Read Boarding Terms / Contact Us / Book Now.
Prices: daily rates; Christmas and New Year supplements; chargeable days; minimum stay; payment and cancellation summary. Actions: Book Now / Ask about dates.
About Us: Intro to owners; family-run background; previously Ali Cats Cattery, now Balnaclash Cattery under new owners; approach to care. Actions: Contact Us / Book Now.
Contact & Find Us: contact form; approved contact details; location and directions; what happens next. Actions: Send a Message / Book Now.
Copy placeholders Use concise temporary text only to demonstrate hierarchy, line length and page flow. Keep these editable placeholders visible to us in the draft: • [Homepage headline to be supplied} • [Short introduction to be supplied] • [Section copy to be supplied] • [Approved contact/location details to be added]
Keep fixed labels where useful, such as Book Now, Prices, Our Cattery, Your Cat’s Stay and Contact Us. I will provide the finished wording after reviewing the design.
4. Confirmed business details for layout These details can be used to size and design the relevant sections. Do not turn them into long promotional copy without approval. Prices • 1 cat: £29 per day • 2 cats sharing: £40 per day • 3 cats sharing: £50 per day • 4 cats sharing: £60 per day • Christmas Day and New Year’s Day: +£15 per day • Boxing Day, 31 December and 2 January: +£10 per day • Heating is included as required. • Arrival and departure days are chargeable. • Usual minimum stay: four days; five days for bookings covering Christmas, New Year and Easter weekend. • Deposit: 25%. Balance due by arrival unless agreed otherwise. Bookings made within seven days of arrival are payable in full at booking. Care information • Family-sized accommodation is available for cats from the same household sharing where appropriate. • A selection of popular wet and dry foods is provided. Owners may bring their cat’s usual, specialist or veterinary food. • Photos and updates can be shared during stays. Do not promise a set frequency. • Vaccination requirements and veterinary evidence are set out in the Boarding Terms. • Agreed oral or topical medication may be accepted. Routine injectable medication is not accepted. • The cattery’s appointed vet is The Pet Hospital Ltd, Livingston. • Operational Hours
5. Temporary imagery and real photography Temporary AI imagery is acceptable in the unpublished design draft to help us assess colour, layout and mood. AI image requirements • Images should look like natural, high-quality photographs, not illustrations or obvious synthetic imagery. • Show a real-looking cat resting or sitting in a believable clean cattery environment, such as a boarding pen with a bed, shelf or hideaway. • Keep the setting modest, calm and plausible for a small UK cattery. • Do not depict a luxury hotel, veterinary clinic, home living room, outdoor garden or facilities that could be mistaken for confirmed features of Balnaclash. • Do not make the cat look distressed, trapped or posed unnaturally. • Label each file and its draft placement. • Keep all AI images easy to replace; do not bake them into backgrounds or use them as the logo. Real photographs to plan for
Prioritise placeholder images: the actual exterior; clean accommodation from more than one angle; beds and hideaways; cats in the accommodation with owner permission; feeding set-up; enrichment; Owners; and a safe arrival/carrier detail. The designer should provide an image list with suggested crop and placement.
6. Squarespace build and access • Use the existing Squarespace 7.1 site and its normal editable sections. • Build the pages and responsive layouts in Squarespace; Figma-only delivery is not sufficient. • Use a restrained, modern editorial layout with the existing brand. • Use landscape images for accommodation, a wide hero image, and square crops for cards where needed. • Check the site at desktop and phone widths. Ensure text, buttons and navigation remain clear and easy to use. • Use a Squarespace contributor invitation • Do not request access to personal email, Google Workspace, Revelation Pets, QuickBooks, banking, payment accounts, domain registrar or personal devices. • Keep the website unpublished and the public domain disconnected until owners approve it.
7. Content, privacy and launch restrictions • Create Space for copy re license details to be added • Create links for the Boarding Terms, Privacy Notice or cookie wording. • Ensure analytics, advertising pixels or new tracking can be enabled once approved • Do not publish the site or connect the public domain. Final copy, real photos, contact details, booking link and licence wording must be added and approved and owners may decide to do that themselves.
8. Milestones and acceptance Suggested milestones: 1. Homepage direction: homepage layout and visual style in the Squarespace draft, with temporary copy and images. 2. Page designs: remaining page structures, navigation and footer using labelled copy placeholders. 3. Functional build: responsive refinements, contact form, Book Now links and approved basic SEO fields. 4. Review and handover: revisions, image replacement list, page-editing notes and access removal after approval.

item.title: Vape E-commerce & EPOS Integration
item.description:

Alongside the core catalogue and checkout, I want customer-facing extras such as product reviews and ratings, an intuitive search with filters for flavour, nicotine strength, device type, etc., plus a simple loyalty programme that rewards repeat purchases.
For the look and feel I’ll share a few reference sites; I’m happy to work from a quality theme or light custom design so you’re not starting from a blank canvas.

Once everything is live, I expect to be able to scan an item in-store, see the stock adjust online instantly, and offer customers a smooth buying experience from discovery to checkout. If you’ve tackled similar vape or high-SKU projects before and know your way around EPOS connectors, I’d love to hear how you’d approach this build and an estimated timeline for each milestone.

item.title: Squarespace Website specialist needed
item.description:

The website is already built and active, so I am not looking for a complete redesign. I need someone who can improve the existing site, keep it updated, make sure everything is functioning properly, and strengthen the website’s SEO so that we have a better opportunity to appear in Google searches for wedding planning services.

Responsibilities would include:
* Updating website copy, photos, pricing, services, and other information as needed * Adding or removing pages and sections when necessary * Making sure the website looks professional and is easy to navigate on desktop, tablet, and mobile * Improving page layouts and organization where needed * Checking links, buttons, forms, and other website functions * Improving website loading speed and overall performance * Optimizing page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, URLs, and other on-page SEO elements * Researching appropriate keywords for wedding planning and event planning services * Optimizing the website for local SEO, particularly for Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and surrounding areas * Helping improve rankings for searches such as Pittsburgh wedding planner, Pittsburgh wedding planning, full-service wedding planner, wedding coordinator, destination wedding planner, and related searches * Reviewing existing website pages to identify SEO opportunities * Making recommendations for new pages, blog posts, FAQs, or content that could improve organic search traffic * Connecting and/or reviewing Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and other appropriate SEO tools * Monitoring basic website SEO performance and making ongoing improvements * Making occasional updates throughout the year as services, pricing, photos, testimonials, and company information change

When responding, please include:
* Examples of Squarespace websites you have worked on * Your experience with SEO and local SEO * Examples of SEO results you have achieved for service-based businesses * Your hourly rate and/or monthly maintenance packages * An explanation of exactly what is included in your SEO services
My primary goal is to have a polished, professional website that stays current while increasing our visibility on Google and generating more qualified wedding planning inquiries.

item.title: Website Optimisation for Digital Art Sales
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I run an online store that offers downloadable abstract art prints. The site is live, theproducts are uploaded, yet the buying journey still feels unfinished and traffic remains modest. I need a hand turning the current setup into a polished, sales-ready experience.
First, every print must be fully commerce-enabled. That means con firming product variants, pricing tiers and automatic delivery links, then wiring each item to a reliable checkout and shipping solution so a customer can buy, download or request physical fulfilment without friction.
Next comes presentation. I want visitors to explore the collection through interactive galleries, zoom into crisp high-resolution images and even preview pieces inside virtual art rooms. You are free to propose the best-fit plugins or custom code, but the end result should feel immersive and load quickly on desktop and mobile alike.
Purchasing should be flexible. Customers must be able to complete the order directly on my site while simultaneously giving me the option to list the same SKUs on an external marketplace. Visibility is the last piece. My goal is higher rankings and more qualified traffic, so the focus is on keyword optimisation and fresh, engaging content around each artwork and artistic theme. Well-structured meta tags, schema, alt text and a concise content plan will be key; backlink outreach is not required right now.
Deliverables • Fully configured product catalogue with seamless checkout and shipping • Interactive gallery, high-resolution zoom and virtual room preview deployed site-wide • Dual sales channel integration (website + chosen marketplace) with synced stock/status • On-page SEO overhaul: keyword mapping, titles, meta, alt text, schema plus a short content calendar • Brief hand-off guide so I can maintain listings and publish new prints in the same workflow

item.title: Comprehensive Client Portal Build
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | We are a marketing and communications company seeking an experienced developer or small team to build a branded client and staff platform.
Our current service runs through account managers who handle website updates and support requests. The portal will let clients manage permitted website content, request assistance, collaborate on projects, approve work, access reports and manage social content.
It must also serve clients hiring us for website builds, surveys, marketing campaigns or consulting, without requiring a connected website or CRM account.
SOW AND EXISTING WORK
The detailed SOW and downloaded GitHub ZIP are available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10tNkYhjd0IWnRud6oHX0ZTCOI9NusLi_?usp=sharing
The existing work is unfinished and requires validation. Reuse is optional. Explain what you would retain, refactor or rebuild, including authentication, permissions, data, storage and workflows.
Preferred stack: Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL/Supabase. A separate backend framework is not mandatory; explain any proposed changes. Visual references and workflow requirements are available. Identify missing screens and include agreed UI completion in your quote.
Please demonstrate experience with secure portals, WordPress/Elementor integrations, approval workflows and APIs.
REQUIRED RELEASE
WordPress Website Editing
Connect our Cloudways-hosted WordPress sites to the portal. Our stack includes Elementor Pro and ACF; other plugins and content patterns vary by site.
Clients must edit permitted text, images, links, documents, posts and approved page sections through a controlled portal interface. Include new pages from approved templates, drafts, previews, approval requests, publishing results and version recovery. Clients can also ask staff to make changes.
Approval and publishing rights are separate. Authorized users can publish directly where enabled; other editors submit for approval. Protect layouts and global settings. Detect direct WordPress changes, prevent silent overwrites and publish the exact approved version when approval is required. Include necessary cache handling and verification of published changes.
We will select a representative site and arrange authorized staging access. The detailed inventory is not complete. Validate supported templates, widgets, ACF fields, content types and editing actions. Identify limitations and preserve existing site functionality.
The early demonstration must cover an Elementor page, a standard post and a new page from an approved template, including editing, preview, approval, publishing, conflict detection and recovery. Access to unrestricted WordPress administration does not satisfy this requirement.
Client Portal
Provide a branded home screen showing the account manager, active services, projects, deadlines, requests and outstanding approvals.
Clients can communicate with staff, submit requests, upload assets, review deliverables, download reports and track progress. Show only their authorized services and actions.
Core project and collaboration features must work without a connected website, Google account or GoHighLevel account.
Staff and Contractor Workspace
Manage clients, projects, milestones, tasks, tickets, recurring work, assignments, files and discussions. Staff can assign work to themselves, authorized colleagues or contractors and complete it themselves.
Include work queues, overdue items, workload, onboarding progress, pending approvals, failed notifications and connection status.
Contractors see only explicitly assigned work, necessary files and designated discussions. Assignment must not expose the entire client or project. Internal staff notes and administration remain private.
Onboarding, Intake and Offboarding
Include editable service-specific intake forms, asset collection, reusable project templates, recurring checklists, invitations, first-login guidance and reminders.
Clients can save and resume forms. Staff can request corrections and track completion. Include service changes, work transfer, permitted exports and access removal.
For connected GoHighLevel accounts, include opportunity-won onboarding with duplicate protection for clients, projects and invitations.
Files, Reports and Approvals
Staff can organize, update and share PDFs and supporting files against the correct client and project. Clients access shared reports; internal files remain private.
Research reports will be prepared externally and uploaded manually. Direct Esri and Leadinfo integrations are not required.
Approvals apply to a specific version. Include comments, requested changes, decision history, due dates, reminders and authorized reassignment. Revisions requiring approval return for review. Overdue approvals must never approve themselves automatically.
Routine support tickets should not require unnecessary client sign-off. Include a searchable client help area maintained by staff.
Social Management, Reporting and GoHighLevel
Clients and staff can create, review, approve and schedule content, with a calendar and publication results. Include supported analytics, downloadable reports and agreed reputation actions such as viewing and replying to reviews.
We already pay for GoHighLevel's full SaaS/white-label service and use its CRM, pipeline, automations and phone/messaging setup. Assess those existing capabilities first. Twilio operates through GoHighLevel; preserve existing numbers, routing and automations.
Facebook, LinkedIn and Google Business Profile are the initial channels to assess. Connected profiles, API permissions, formats, metrics and supported actions still need verification. Identify capabilities that are tested, unverified or blocked, plus any additional applications, provider approvals, subscriptions or usage charges.
Track publication separately for each destination, handle partial failures and prevent duplicate posts during retries. Review requests should use the approved existing GoHighLevel workflow without duplicate sending.
Social management/reporting and agreed GoHighLevel onboarding are required. The customer inbox is a separate option below.
Permissions, Branding and Security
Support Agency Admin, Staff, Contractor, Client Admin, Client Member and Client Viewer roles, with separate viewing, editing, approval and publishing rights.
Enforce agency, client, project and assignment boundaries through database RLS and server authorization across APIs, files, search, exports, notifications and background jobs.
Include privileged-user MFA, private file access and audit history. Recheck authorization when queued actions execute. Removing an assignment must revoke access granted by it, including further access through previously shared portal links.
Only one agency will be live initially. Support separate agencies in the architecture and use a second staging agency for isolation and revocation tests. Commercial reseller rollout and reseller-specific domains are outside this release.
Keep agency branding separate from client identity. Include branded invitations, welcome/recovery emails and responsive client/staff screens.
Website and Launch Records
Provide a staff register for websites, domains, hosting, technical contacts, connection status and renewal responsibility.
Include staging review, client launch approval, launch checklists and verification records. Domain, hosting, infrastructure and data ownership remain under our control.
SEPARATELY PRICED OPTIONS
Google/Facebook sign-in for convenience. Email/password login, invitations and recovery are required. Optional sign-in must not bypass permissions or MFA.
Selection and sharing of existing Google Drive documents.
Viewing and replying to customer SMS/email conversations inside the portal through GoHighLevel.
Cloudways/Cloudflare status synchronization or authorized infrastructure controls beyond cache handling needed for publishing.
DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS
Include technical planning, code assessment and compatibility validation within the project. We are not purchasing a separate assessment.
Develop and deploy in accounts we control, committing source code to our repository throughout. Your team handles technical setup; we provide business decisions, authorized access and owner consent.
Include testing, daily off-site backups with at least 30-day retention, restore verification, documentation, staff training, handover and 90 days of post-launch defect fixes. Quote ongoing maintenance separately.
Launch website/profile counts are not finalized. State how many client accounts, websites and social profiles your fixed price includes and the costs for additional connections or new compatibility patterns.
There is no confirmed hard launch date. Propose a realistic schedule for the complete required release, including demonstrations, testing, training and deployment.
YOUR PROPOSAL MUST INCLUDE
Relevant working examples and your specific role.
Your approach to Elementor editing, permissions, approvals and recovery.
What you would reuse, refactor or rebuild.
A fixed total for the complete required scope, milestone deliverables and acceptance criteria.
Separately priced options.
Schedule, dependencies, compatibility limits and exclusions.
Recurring costs, distinguishing existing subscriptions from new expenses.
Who performs development, design, testing and support.
Whether your posted bid is the full-scope price or a preliminary amount.
The SOW defines requirements and acceptance checks. Flag conflicts, assumptions and exclusions before agreement. Include contingency in the fixed price and schedule; changes require written agreement.
